layout.sidebar: w-full md:w-[380px] border-r border-border bg-surface h-screen overflow-y-auto p-6 flex flex-col gap-8
layout.main_canvas: flex-1 h-[50vh] md:h-screen bg-background relative overflow-hidden
layout.spacing: Dense for controls (gap-4), generous for structural sections (gap-8). Padding inside containers must be generous to avoid content collision.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), no drop shadows by default. 4px border-radius.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm or rounded-md). Solid contrast colors. Hover: bg-opacity-90. Use data-testid on all buttons.
components.inputs: Use JetBrains Mono for the math input fields. No background fill, strict 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-primary offset.
components.sliders: Custom shadcn slider. The slider thumb and track should ideally match the color of the mathematical trace it controls for visual mapping.
components.plotly_chart: Must use 'paper_bg': 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' and 'plot_bg': 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' to inherit Tailwind backgrounds. Disable default Plotly logo in config.

motion.sliders: Real-time UI updates on drag. Real-time plot updates.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over surfaces meets 4.5:1 minimum. Graph traces must be highly distinct.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have visible focus rings.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='add-function-button', data-testid='function-input-0', data-testid='variable-slider-A')

instructions_to_main_agent: Structure: Implement a responsive Sidebar + Main Canvas layout. Sidebar contains math inputs, generated sliders, and settings. Main Canvas contains the full-width/height Plotly component.
Math Logic: Extract mathematical variables (e.g. A, B, C) excluding the chosen independent variable (like x or t) using mathjs.parse or regex.
Slider Generation: Dynamically render a slider for each unique variable detected in the active functions.
Typography: Apply Chivo for headings, IBM Plex Sans for UI, and JetBrains Mono for all math equations, inputs, and Plotly axis/tick labels.
Theme: Implement theme toggling (Light/Dark). Watch for Plotly's layout updates dynamically when the theme changes (e.g., updating gridline, tick, and axis title colors).
Export Feature: Use Plotly's Plotly.downloadImage or standard config modebar button for high-quality PNG export.
Testing Requirements: Ensure you append clear, role-based data-testid attributes to all buttons, form inputs, sliders, and interactive icons.
